method: Compare candidate to erest control within the same round, framework, scenario and concurrency. Profile runs are excluded from performance comparisons. Paired ranges are not confidence intervals.

profiles.window: Last 2000ms of each profile, including stop/forced GC/exit. Sampled self time is approximate and cannot isolate allocations or prove causality. Profile timings are excluded from optimization comparisons.

cases.expectedIncompatibility: Misses mutation to Web Headers before dispatch

findings.scope: Apple M2, Node.js 24.22.1, POST with params/query/nested body, concurrency 50. 60 + 39 screening samples and 35 H3 confirmation samples; 9 profiling processes excluded from gain comparisons.
items: 共完成 134 次非 profiler 性能采样，计时区间 HTTP/网络错误均为 0。初筛为 3 轮、预热 2s/测量 3s；H3 复核为 7 轮、预热 3s/测量 5s。所有收益均按同框架、场景、并发和轮次配对，不直接比较不同阶段的绝对吞吐。

最值得继续调查的是 H3 headers 转换。Node 原始 headers 复制的 7 轮吞吐配对中位变化为 +7.12%（+5.26% ～ +7.58%），CPU 约减少 1.624 μs/请求；相对未改动副本为 +6.98%。但 P95 增加约 0.584ms，且真实 HTTP 检查证明它会漏掉路由前对 Web Headers 的修改，因此不能直接替换现有实现。重复头/数组规范化和跨运行时行为也需保留。
保持 Web Headers 路径的 forEach 复制通过了特殊 __proto__ 字段、重复头、快照时机、相同对象及普通对象原型检查。7 轮相对现有 erest 的配对中位变化为 +0.93%；相对隔离副本为 +0.85%，范围 -1.29% ～ +1.22%。未改动副本本身也有 -0.33% ～ +2.54% 波动，目前不足以确认稳定收益。
通用微调没有明显赢家：预绑定校验器的吞吐配对中位变化在 -0.40% ～ +0.36%；Object.assign 参数合并在 -0.34% ～ +0.66%；同步 handler 包装在 -0.18% ～ +0.61%。这些范围是不同框架的中位值，非置信区间，初筛只有 3 轮。
共享 Reply 原型方法没有可靠收益，各框架配对中位变化为 -0.68% ～ +0.24%，也未明显降低 RSS 或存活堆。该写法还改变方法枚举和脱离对象调用时的行为，不值得为当前收益承担兼容性变化。Express 第二阶段有一次对照吞吐明显上升；保留该样本，不用单轮结果归因。
排除 getter 式延迟 headers 的当前实现：H3 吞吐约 -1.26%，CPU 增加约 5.895 μs/请求，RSS 配对中位增量约 157 MiB。此结果反对该具体实现，不能推出所有惰性或基于类的上下文设计都更慢。
Express 的短测 RSS 仍高于原生加 Zod，GC 后堆差距约 1.6～1.7 MiB。不同采样时长的 RSS 不能直接作泄漏或分配速率结论。若要降低峰值内存，下一步应采集分配/GC 时间序列并延长运行，不应基于单次 RSS 引入跨请求 Context/Reply 池。
本轮只新增隔离实验、兼容性检查、报告工具和数据，没有修改公开运行时代码。建议暂不合并这些诊断变体到运行时；优先研究保持 Web Headers 修改可见性及规范化行为的 H3 headers 快照构建，再独立复测。发压客户端在部分 H3 组接近一个逻辑核，吞吐不能视为服务端容量上限。

descriptions: Capture compiled schemas, requiredOneOf and onValidate at bind time; validate ctx directly.
caveats: Must retain existing hook binding semantics and all layered/requiredOneOf behavior.

descriptions: Replace four object spreads for flat params with Object.assign.
caveats: Diagnostic only: Object.assign treats an own __proto__ key differently; not safe to ship unchanged.

descriptions: Avoid unconditional async typed-handler wrapper; resolve async results via a shared finish callback.
caveats: Check rejection, response schemas, envelope return bookkeeping and async onion middleware before shipping.

descriptions: Lazily materialize H3 ctx.headers on first access, cache the object and keep a setter.
caveats: Header snapshot timing/property descriptors differ; reject as a drop-in optimization without an API decision.

descriptions: Node-only diagnostic: copy IncomingMessage headers instead of converting Web Headers.
caveats: Not portable; raw array/duplicate-header normalization and mutations to Web Headers can differ. This is an attribution experiment, not a shippable replacement.

descriptions: Use per-request Reply instances with shared prototype methods instead of four per-request method closures.
caveats: Prototype/enumerability and detached method calls differ. Requires a compatibility decision and broad Reply tests before shipping.
